mintAuthority.summary: SBC is issued by Brale (FinCEN MSB / U.S. money transmitter) across EVM, Solana, Stellar, and Tempo deployments. The tracked EVM deployments use UUPS-upgradeable AccessControl contracts with chain-local UPGRADER_ROLE authorities: 3-of-6 Safes on Ethereum, Polygon, and Avalanche, and the Brale issuance EOA on Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Celo, and Ethereum Classic. Solana uses a 1-of-2 SPL mint-authority multisig; Stellar uses its native issuer account; and Tempo TIP-20 assigns both DEFAULT_ADMIN and ISSUER to one Brale-controlled EOA.

controls.label: Brale issuance EOA — MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712410, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb180f98037a63a3dca66b6b4ddbf250265b65110) and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, the same address) both returned true, while eth_getCode returned 0x, establishing the current Brale issuance authority as an EOA. Historical mint transactions and the reviewed cross-chain role reads identify the same Brale EOA on the other EVM issuer-native deployments.

controls.label: Proxy upgrade authority — Ethereum Safe (6 signers, threshold 3, UPGRADER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712410, hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0x4d16d9e3358b68638e25f631ac861fa40a8fb87e) returned true and the SBC EIP-1967 implementation remained 0x935eda0060ba40ea409bb05fa2300abb4e215ac1. Contrary to the prior 'legacy multisig, not Safe' label, the authority bytecode is a Safe proxy: getOwners() returned the six listed EOAs, getThreshold() returned 3, VERSION() returned 1.3.0, getModulesPaginated() returned none, the canonical guard and fallback-handler slots were zero, and singleton slot 0 resolved Safe master copy 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552. The Brale minter EOA does not hold Ethereum UPGRADER_ROLE.

controls.label: Proxy upgrade authority — Polygon Safe (6 signers, threshold 3, UPGRADER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90219432, hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0xcf64b5d44f6aa845d857a008d3c5465cfa80214a) = true. The authority is a Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 proxy: getOwners() returned six owners, getThreshold() = 3, getModulesPaginated() returned an empty array, and Safe guard storage slot 6 was zero. The SBC EIP-1967 implementation slot contained 0xc1bc0450f8bb1386ffd5150cbb3ad38da1f0dd12 and the admin slot was zero.

controls.label: SBC Solana SPL mint authority (1-of-2 Token Program multisig)
controls.evidence: At Solana finalized slot 432863929, getAccountInfo for mint DBAzBUXaLj1qANCseUPZz4sp9F8d2sc78C4vKjhbTGMA returned owner TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA and an 82-byte SPL Mint account with mintAuthority = 8Dn2V6HX6gTwkCid2MUiv3mXvMkTcyxQeqTychdBRBSj. That authority account is a 355-byte SPL Token multisig with m = 1, n = 2, signers 82GvnsFEPfs8xq8poGax4HNjZi98LK7Lg7Btr9zx5cD and 3W4UiZLF5TckYg34mDGe1Kno2RZdp8DiiMRF9pAkxvfk. The canonical Token Program is the immutable minting runtime; the multisig retains direct mint and authority-change capability.

controls.label: SBC Stellar native issuer account
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63473878, Horizon reports the SBC issuer account GCQCNWT22JDLENQAVIE6DRJGHWAQ6EX2H5ABGPV55EJUPPZM5UA7KHZR with one ed25519 signer of weight 1, low/medium/high thresholds all zero, auth_revocable = true, and auth_clawback_enabled = true. Stellar issued assets use the issuer account as the native issuance authority; there is no upgradeable token contract or separate program logic to review.

controls.label: SBC Tempo TIP-20 issuer and default-admin EOA
controls.capDescription: Tempo Explorer reports the SBC TIP-20 supply cap as Unlimited. The same EOA holds ISSUER, which can mint, and DEFAULT_ADMIN, which administers roles and supply-cap configuration under TIP-20.

sources.label: Tempo Explorer SBC TIP-20 roles and configuration

controls.evidence: At Tempo block 33856846 on 2026-08-08, Tempo Explorer's TIP-20 role endpoint returned rolesUnavailable=false and exactly DEFAULT_ADMIN plus ISSUER for SBC, both held by 0x9b2ac01262756f76cd49a60060b43471c8473e7f. The same endpoint reported supplyCap=Unlimited, totalSupply=46.26 SBC, decimals=6, paused=false, and transferPolicyId=1. eth_getCode for the authority returned 0x, establishing an EOA. The official TIP-20 specification assigns mint authority to ISSUER_ROLE and role/supply-cap administration to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

review.evidence: Current EVM role reads confirm chain-local upgrade authorities: Ethereum block 25712410 uses Safe 0x4d16d9e3; Arbitrum block 483773115, Optimism block 154217718, Base block 48622433, Celo block 72133454, and Ethereum Classic block 24947752 use Brale EOA 0xb180f98; Polygon block 90219432 uses Safe 0xcf64b5d4; Avalanche block 90290804 uses Safe 0xa8cdd1c1. The Ethereum authority was corrected from 'legacy multisig, not Safe' to Safe v1.3.0 after fresh runtime, VERSION(), owner, threshold, module, guard, fallback-handler, and singleton reads; all three Safe authorities are 3-of-6 with no enabled modules and zero guard storage. Solana uses the immutable canonical Token Program with a 1-of-2 mint-authority multisig, and Stellar uses its native issuer account with one weight-1 signer and no threshold elevation. The previously omitted Tempo deployment was closed on 2026-08-08: at block 33856846, TIP-20 roles and configuration identify EOA 0x9b2ac01262756f76cd49a60060b43471c8473e7f as both DEFAULT_ADMIN and ISSUER and report an Unlimited supply cap. This completes the control identity inventory for all 11 tracked deployments. MCCPA/Abdo performs monthly independent examinations; the latest reviewed report covers May 31, 2026, was published June 9, 2026, and fully reconciles SBC liabilities to reserve assets. Brale's disclosed FinCEN MSB and state money-transmitter status does not establish prudential issuer supervision comparable to a banking, trust, or EMI charter, so supervision is attestation-only.
